claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair.
claims.evidence: Witness only shows a front-loading LG washer-dryer with control panel and door; no operation test, no error codes, and no proof of non-working status.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Witness did not capture age/usage indicators (e.g., usage hours, service sticker) and only noted some scuffing/marks on the lower front panel and around the door area.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Witness did not show internal access, motor condition, or any diagnostic results; only external front view was reported.
Witness did not show documents; availability is not confirmed by the report.

risks.risk: It may not wash or may not dry (dryer heating element and control board could be faulty), which heavily affects value.
risks.proof: Short video clip of a full wash cycle starting from cold water to completion, plus a dryer cycle showing heat/airflow and no error codes on the display.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-working/needs repair (worst case), since no test results are shown.

risks.risk: Drum interior and rubber door seal may be damaged or stained, causing leaks, poor cleaning, or mold/odor.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drum interior and the full rubber door seal (front and sides), plus a quick leak check while running.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically and functionally uncertain; treat as potentially needing seal/drum cleaning or replacement.

risks.risk: Water inlet/drain issues (hoses, pump, filter) could prevent proper draining or cause flooding.
risks.proof: Clip showing water filling and draining during a cycle, and a photo of the drain hose/pump area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case plumbing/drain fault risk included (non-working until proven).

risks.risk: Hidden electrical/control faults (display errors, sensor faults) may not be visible externally.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the display during startup and during the first minutes of operation, including any error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially faulty electronics (worst case) until error-free operation is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage may indicate rough handling or prior issues (scuffing/marks noted).
risks.proof: Additional photos of both sides, back panel, top, and the door rim/hinge area in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic condition within the shown front scuffing.

proof_requests: Video of a complete wash cycle (start to finish) with the display visible and no error codes.
Video of a complete dryer cycle showing heating/working (heat/airflow) and no error codes.
Close-up photos of the drum interior and the entire rubber door seal.
Photos of the back panel and any model/serial label (for exact model verification).
Photos of the warranty card and receipt (if available) showing date of purchase.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg front-loading washer-dryer, but there is no evidence of whether it works or what exactly is faulty. Without an operation test or error-code proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
